passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Quercus × senneniana A.Camus.
The native range of this hybrid is Iberian Peninsula. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is Q. faginea × Q. rotundifolia.
